ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened modestly higher, led by Bitcoin (+0.95%) and Ethereum (+0.82%) on Delta India, while Solana slipped and XRP remained flat. The uptober hype and easing US bond yields support the upside, but recent NEAR exploits and regulatory delays keep risk in focus.
